name: 45514-sharedprefix-7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1); the node also carries 208 vCPUs.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process engine. No context parallelism, no KV connector, no offload tier, no router.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, 800 requests bounded, safety_seconds 3600.
workload: Shared-context single-turn chat, text only, 800 independent requests. Each is a fresh two-message conversation: a system message holding one of 4 distinct 28000-token standing contexts chosen uniformly at random, then a 1024-token user message unique to that request, generating 32 tokens; nothing is carried between requests. In guidellm this is `synthetic_text` with `turns: 1`, one prefix bucket (prefix_count 4, prefix_tokens 28000), prompt_tokens 1024 and output_tokens 32, all fixed rather than sampled, so the rendered prompt is ~29.0k tokens. Sampling is greedy (temperature 0.0). Transport is guidellm's in-process `vllm_python` backend, which supports single-turn requests only.
purpose: A policy-document question answering service on one GPU, where single users send long standing contexts with brief queries.
launch:
# The launch config, in `vllm serve --config` form.

model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct

tensor-parallel-size: 1

# The checkpoint's own trained window; the ~29.0k rendered prompt sits inside it.
max-model-len: 32768

max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

enable-prefix-caching: true
enable-chunked-prefill: true

# Everything else is left at this engine's own defaults, and no environment variables
# belong to this item.
